notes: Source: HuggingFace MCG-NJU/SportsMOT, dataset/val.tar (6.59 GB, MOT17-style layout), val split (45 sequences, 15 each basketball/football/volleyball). Downloaded 2026-07-17.

OPEN COMPLIANCE ITEM: SportsMOT's upstream distribution is gated behind a CodaLab agreement (incl. 'do not redistribute without prior written permission'). The HF val.tar LFS object is served publicly (X-Xet-Cas-Uid=public), so this download did NOT click through that gate -- the agreement's terms were not affirmatively accepted. Current use is benchmark-only (no training on it, no redistribution), which is reasonably bounded, but because the product is commercial this needs an explicit recorded licensing sign-off by the owner of product licensing risk, not closure by an engineering note. Raised at SPO-16; unresolved at manifest-commit time.

Subset rationale: SportsMOT's value over the SoccerNet tier is cross-sport motion diversity (fast camera motion, near-identical appearance, crowded scenes), so all three sports are represented; all 9 chosen sequences are from distinct source videos, so no correlated clips straddle the held-out/tuning boundary.

held_out (6): 2 per sport -- football v_2QhNRucNC7E_c017, v_G-vNjfx1GGc_c004; basketball v_00HRwkvvjtQ_c001, v_4r8QL_wglzQ_c001; volleyball v_0kUtTtmLaJA_c004, v_4-EmEtrturE_c009. Ingested 2026-07-17 via `pitchlab-train ingest-sportsmot --split val --sequences <names> --role held_out`. Verified never referenced by any tuning config or experiment: `git grep -n <seq> -- configs/ packages/pitchlab_train/` returns nothing (excluding this manifest).

tuning (3): 1 per sport -- football v_ITo3sCnpw_k_c007; basketball v_5ekaksddqrc_c001; volleyball v_9MHDmAMxO5I_c002. Ingested via the same command with --role tuning. Reserved for calibration / parameter sweeps (e.g. SPO-22).

held_out sequences must never be added to a tuning config, experiment YAML, or ablation sweep; if a held-out sequence is ever referenced by one, re-classify it as tuning and draw a fresh held-out set.

36 remaining val sequences stay inside the upstream dataset/val.tar and are available for future held-out/tuning expansion; extending the subset requires re-extracting from that tarball (the raw per-sequence frames under data/sportsmot/val/ are gitignored).
